note:
Trial 17 ended on the 90-second timeout.

**What happened on screen:**
- Combat opened with a spider charging down the hill in front of me. I landed roughly three sword swings and it disappeared from view, with what looked like a drop on the ground, though I cannot confirm the kill from the screenshots alone.
- I then swept the camera in a full circle. The landscape was open grass, water, and trees with no hostiles visible for most of the sweep.
- Late in the sweep a second spider appeared on the hilltop to the upper left. I advanced toward it with the shield raised, but it moved out of sight behind the ridge before I could close the distance.
- While backing up to get a view of the hilltop, the screen showed "TRIAL END: TIMEOUT". My health bar stayed full the whole trial.

**Input problems:** None observed. Camera turns, movement, shield, and attack inputs all registered as expected. The main cost was time spent on the 360-degree scan with small turn increments and the shield blocking the view while approaching.
